description: This file defines a StatusBadge component and related specialized badges for displaying various statuses (agent state, health, lifecycle) with icons, labels, and styling. It uses imported UI components, icons, and utility functions to render status indicators based on input props.

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: Main status badge component that displays icons and labels based on agent status, state, health, or lifecycle, with customizable size and styling.

methods.name: AgentStateBadge
methods.description: Specialized badge for displaying agent state.

methods.name: HealthStatusBadge
methods.description: Specialized badge for displaying health status.

methods.name: LifecycleStatusBadge
methods.description: Specialized badge for displaying lifecycle status.

methods.name: getHealthScoreColor
methods.description: Returns color styling based on a numerical health score.

methods.name: getHealthScoreBadgeVariant
methods.description: Returns badge variant style based on a numerical health score.
